name: 7-Eleven Combined Distribution Center Salt Lake City UT (E.A. Sween)

fieldNotes.truckGate: Open, uncontrolled access. The Google Street View car drove the entire interior truck yard freely (multiple interior panos), which only happens at open sites. No barrier arm, sliding/swing gate, or checkpoint pinch-point where the property meets Swaner Road. Only a low decorative chain-link fence with a hedge along the employee-parking edge; the truck driveways open directly off the road.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No staffed booth at any entrance. No 1-3-space windowed structure beside the truck lane in satellite or any Street View frame. The only small structure near the entrance is a fleet fuel-island canopy and the Penske fleet-maintenance building, not a gatehouse.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: False because there is no truck gate at all (no gate => no remote check-in). No kiosk or call box observed.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Large open paved yard inside the property between the road and the dock faces where trucks queue/stage; ample holding room.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Deep internal approach from Swaner Road across the yard to the dock faces easily holds a queue of 3+ trucks.
fieldNotes.entryExitTogether: Two open driveway connections to Swaner Road serve both in and out; no dedicated separate in/out gates. Counted truckGateCount as 2 driveways but they are uncontrolled openings.
fieldNotes.entryLanes: Open driveways ~1 truck-lane wide each; lane count is nominal at an uncontrolled site.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Main building shows a regular rhythm of dock doors on its west and south faces with reefer trailers backed in; counted ~22 across faces from z20-z21 imagery, placing it in the 10-25 band (flagged as estimate).
fieldNotes.dropArea: Very dense reefer-trailer drop/parking yard west of the building in a fan/herringbone pattern; well over 50 trailers + tractors visible, so 50+ band.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Dedicated on-site reefer-trailer storage lot, distinct from the active dock apron.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Docks read as one operational cluster wrapping the west/south building faces; no clearly separate ship vs receive banks on different faces.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Inside Salt Lake City's dense Glendale industrial fabric just west of I-15; Urban.
fieldNotes.scale: No truck scale / weigh pad observed in the truck path.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Two buildings on the audited property (main distribution building + adjoining Penske fleet-maintenance/office building), but a single operation, not a multi-cluster campus.
fieldNotes.railServed: A rail line runs along the far (east) side of Swaner Road serving a neighboring materials yard; no spur enters the E.A. Sween property.
fieldNotes.location: Confirmed via address 1172 S Swaner Rd, UT 84104 and Nominatim geocode 40.7441475, -111.9520720. On-site Penske Truck Leasing (Yelp) and fleet-maintenance bays match the E.A. Sween CDC. Neighboring lumber/materials yards to west and south were excluded from the geofence.
